Leona has invited Biscuit to join the group.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: What's this all about?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: we are obviously together,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: so why'd you create a group chat with everyone?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Although she was pretty confident,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm a little worried about Guillotine back at the shelter.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I was wondering how she's holding up.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Zoo Keeper,

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: could you add her to the chat?
Sure.
{AccountData.NickName} has invited Guillotine to join the group.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I am a being for whom darkness is my dwelling.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Who dares summon me

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: into this unknown space?
It was me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Ah, Partner!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I asked him to invite you, hehe.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: So, you all are here as well?

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This is not good.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: This may sound alarming to you all,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: but you must never tell anyone that you were in the same space as me.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Not a word!

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: If you let it slip that we were together,

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: you yourselves might end up in the Big O's crosshairs.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Yikes.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Don't worry, we won't mention anything.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Yeah, we won't tell a soul.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: By the way,

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: are the dogs having a good time?

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: And don't forget the cats.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I just took the dogs on a walk.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Seeing them become so affectionate for a nobody like me got me thinking:

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Perhaps even a damned soul like myself is capable of being loved.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: The cats are frolicking around.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: They're enjoying their solitude.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: In fact, they remind me of myself.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That's great!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Thanks, Guillotine.

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: There can be a learning curve when it comes to taking care of cats,

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: but it sounds like you've got it down pat.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: But of course. Did you expect anything less?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Sounds like things are going quite nicely over there.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Are you not curious about Timi de Vista?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I'm sure you're taking good care of him, so I'm not worried.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: I appreciate the vote of confidence.

lines.speaker: guillotine
lines.text: Don't worry, I've got things covered on this end.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Okay, much appreciated.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Thanks!

lines.speaker: nero
lines.text: Thank you, meow.
